SUBJECT:
Woods Landing Estates
DATE:
April 19,2016
The Cheyenne Metropolitan Planning Organization began meeting with City&County
Planning and County Public Works personnel the end of December,2015 to discuss
Woods Landing Estates and the preservation of future classified roads and rights of way
of the Long Range Transportation Plan network(specifically the Storey/Summit
alignment).With this development action, the MPO requests a condition on thisplat for
right of way to be dedicated for the future Storey/Summit: The southwestern parcel of
this plat shall have fifty feet of east westright of way beginning from the intersection of
Storey and Robert Parker Trail and then gradually taper to Orights ofway at the
southwestern corner of the parcel and plat.This would create a sliver of right of way that
would allow thefuture Storey/Summit to swing southward around a natural hillside, to
meet upwith thefull right of way of future Storey/Summit beyond thisplat tothewest.
